title: EMPLOYEE REQUEST
body: {name} would like to attend an art conference.

choices.label: APPROVE
choices.outcome: {name} comes back from the conference with a notebook full of ideas.

choices.label: DECLINE
choices.outcome: {name} accepts the answer, but it is noted.

title: TEAM FRICTION
body: {name} and another member of {their} team keep butting heads, and it is starting to show in the work.

choices.label: MEDIATE
choices.outcome: You sit them both down. It is an awkward hour, but they agree to keep it professional.

choices.label: STAY OUT OF IT
choices.outcome: You leave them to sort it out themselves. The mood on the team stays sour for weeks.

choices.label: REPLACE
choices.outcome: A replacement machine is on the desk by the end of the day.

choices.label: MAKE DO
choices.outcome: The team shares machines while a fix is arranged.
